s1.facts: Two participants past or within 180 days of RBD and not yet in pay. Applications to be sent per TP 20.2.

participants.note: Past RBD, not yet in pay.

s2.eprdLanguage: The earliest PBGC retirement date is the participant’s earliest annuity date where that date is on or after age 55; otherwise age 55, unless the facts-and-circumstances test supports an earlier date.

s3.facts: No beneficiaries entitled to retroactive QPSAs. No participant died before DOPT with an unnotified spouse.

s4.facts: The 1979 plan provided different early retirement factors than the DOPT document.

earlierSets.description: ERF 1/180 per month first 60 months, then 1/360; DOPT document uses 1/15 per year.

s5.facts: No restriction on benefits payable while receiving benefits from another source was found in the plan documents.
